reviews.author: Vincent Jones
reviews.text: Stumbled upon this club a few months ago as a beginner to chess. This environment has allowed me to forge deep, enriching connections, and I continue to build more every week.

reviews.author: Israel Carromero
reviews.text: Great place to play chess and meet other players. The atmosphere is relaxed, the people are friendly, and there’s a good mix of skill levels. It’s nice having a place where you can sit down, play a few games, and enjoy the game without it feeling overly competitive. I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Madison Dennis
reviews.text: Side effects: may leave you feeling an obsessive attachment to chess tactics and falling in love with Harold the club manager 💚

reviews.author: Alex Galante
reviews.text: Solid chess club with relaxed, beginner-friendly vibes and good organization/leadership.

reviews.author: Sonny Parlin
reviews.text: Excellent chess club, very cool people!
